title: Ordinary direct-image chain squares for Mayer–Vietoris
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and $U,V\subseteq Y$ arbitrary opens. Let $I$ be an unbounded cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and $J$ one of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules. Write $F=h_*$ applied termwise [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], and let $f:F(I)\to J$ be a supplied chain map. For the open-image complexes, units $\eta$ and unsigned restriction maps $\rho$ of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data], there exist chain maps $a:F(j_{h^{-1}U,*}I|_{h^{-1}U})\to j_{U,*}J|_U$, $b:F(j_{h^{-1}V,*}I|_{h^{-1}V})\to j_{V,*}J|_V$, and $c:F(j_{h^{-1}U\cap h^{-1}V,*}I|_{h^{-1}U\cap h^{-1}V})\to j_{U\cap V,*}J|_{U\cap V}$ satisfying $f;\eta_U=F(\eta_{h^{-1}U});a$, $f;\eta_V=F(\eta_{h^{-1}V});b$, $a;\rho_{U,U\cap V}=F(\rho_{h^{-1}U,h^{-1}U\cap h^{-1}V});c$, and $b;\rho_{V,U\cap V}=F(\rho_{h^{-1}V,h^{-1}U\cap h^{-1}V});c$. No cover, injectivity, derived category, or resolution is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), displayed complex, and 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open), underived sectionwise identity; official Stacks pages read online

proof.text: Use the underived open restriction and open composition isomorphisms of def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model. For an open A of Y, their composite identifies h_*j_{h^{-1}A,*}(I|h^{-1}A) with j_{A,*}((h_*I)|A). On a test open B both evaluate to I(h^{-1}(B intersect A)); the equality of inverse image with intersection identifies the section groups and their scalar actions. Apply this degreewise to complexes: naturality of the isomorphisms makes the section identifications commute with differentials.

For A equal to U, V, or U intersect V, compose the preceding comparison with j_{A,*} of restriction of the supplied chain map f. For the intersection use h^{-1}(U intersect V)=h^{-1}U intersect h^{-1}V. These are a, b, and c. No localized representative or derived resolution is chosen.

Under the section identifications, the transported unit is restriction from B to B intersect A: unfold the definition schemeOpenModuleAdjunction and its transport along overFunctorEquiv. The first two equations are f_B followed by this restriction equals the same restriction followed by f_{B intersect A}, which is naturality of the sheaf morphism f in each degree. Equality on all section modules and in all degrees proves the two chain equations.

Unfold the mate formula for schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction. The inverse nested restriction comparison restricts twice, the counit removes the repeated larger-open restriction, and the forward comparison identifies the result with the smaller-open restriction. Thus its section component is restriction from B intersect U or B intersect V to B intersect U intersect V. Naturality of f at these two inclusions proves the last two equations. The construction uses no covering or injectivity, and the same section computations apply to empty and repeated opens and zero complexes.

theorem schemeMV_directImage_chain_squares
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J) :
    let F := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ (a : F.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) I) ⟶
        schemeOpenModuleImageComplex Y U J)
      (b : F.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) I) ⟶
        schemeOpenModuleImageComplex Y V J)
      (c : F.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V)) I) ⟶
        schemeOpenModuleImageComplex Y (U ⊓ V) J),
      f ≫ schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit Y U J =
        F.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) I) ≫ a ∧
      f ≫ schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit Y V J =
        F.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit X (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) I) ≫ b ∧
      a ≫ schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction Y (homOfLE inf_le_left) J =
        F.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_left) I) ≫ c ∧
      b ≫ schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction Y (homOfLE inf_le_right) J =
        F.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_right) I) ≫ c
